metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for developer productivity.

plugins.name: repo-to-notebooklm
plugins.description: Converts a code repository into a single readable document that can be uploaded to NotebookLM for AI-powered podcast generation and Q&A.

plugins.name: repo-setup
plugins.description: Bootstrap a freshly cloned repository: read docs, detect the stack, install dependencies, configure environment, auto-generate non-secret values, and verify the project runs.

plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Re-explain Claude's most recent message or explanation in the simplest possible terms, as if explaining to a 5-year-old.

plugins.name: cross-review
plugins.description: Cross-model code review: runs an independent review with a different model, then independently validates every finding before surfacing it.

plugins.name: seedance-higgsfield
plugins.description: Turn rough video ideas into structured Seedance 2.5 prompts, and generate them through the Higgsfield MCP server with cost checks.

plugins.name: screen-tutorial-edit
plugins.description: Edit a 16:9 YouTube-style tutorial from a camera recording plus screen recordings: face in a tracked circle over the screen, synced zooms, privacy blur, tight cuts by audio, optional bottom-centre captions.

plugins.name: il-supermarket-compare
plugins.description: Find the cheapest supermarket near you in Israel for a whole shopping list, using today's official price-transparency files from the chains.
